runtime_requirements: Address Library for F4SE Plugins matching Fallout 4 1.11.240
optional_runtime_integrations: F4SE Menu Framework (DCCStudios/F4SEMenuFramework) hosts SYNTH's native in-game settings pages and hotkey registry; SYNTH registers through its consumer API, ships no MCM config, and remains fully configurable through SYNTH_custom.ini without it
package_does_not_include: Bethesda, Creation Club or third-party ESP/ESL/ESM/PEX/BA2 files; the only plugin and scripts shipped are SYNTH's original Data/SYNTH.esp, SYNTHWait and (when built) SYNTHNative, each audited against its tracked source
